Assisted living and nursing facility transportation

Coordinated transportation for assisted living and nursing facility residents.

Planning your trip

Facility staff or families can share resident transportation needs, pickup access, appointment details and the receiving contact. Confirm handoff responsibilities and return arrangements with the team.

Can a facility coordinate transportation for a resident?

Yes. A facility coordinator can provide trip details and assistance needs for the transportation team to review.

Details to have ready

  • Resident mobility and boarding needs
  • Facility and receiving contact
  • Pickup access, handoff and return arrangements

How to arrange a ride

Choose assisted living and nursing facility transportation and prepare the trip details. The transportation team must review your request, vehicle suitability and availability before confirming pickup. A calendar appointment or prepared request alone does not confirm transportation.
